about: Ingredients of a dish that Kuro's wiki has wrong, and what the game asks for (PLAN.md D155). Per dish: 'was' is the name the dish's page gives one ingredient, and the fix is applied only while the page still says that; 'now' is what the game calls it, checked there by hand. The amount is the page's. Applied when recipes.json is read (catalogue.apply_recipe_fixes).
